info.title: r2f2 Website API
info.description: Browser uses HttpOnly cookies; App uses Supabase Bearer access token. All responses are private/no-store. Email is the login identifier; nicknames are display names only. Item, skill, set and order names use the browser r2f2-locale cookie or the App Accept-Language header. English and Chinese are sourced from game XML; Spanish falls back to English. The default is English.

get.summary: List public game items or sets in one category
get.description: The name, skill and set member names are localized to the selected language. The response varies by Cookie or Accept-Language.

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: Defaults to sword

parameters.name: Accept-Language
parameters.description: App clients: en, zh-CN, or es. Browser clients use r2f2-locale Cookie instead.

get.summary: List the authenticated player's orders, newest first
get.description: Item names follow the browser locale cookie or App Accept-Language. Legacy orders fall back to their original name snapshot if the current catalog is unavailable or the item no longer exists.

parameters.name: Accept-Language
parameters.description: App clients: en, zh-CN, or es. Browser clients use r2f2-locale Cookie instead.

post.summary: Create one pending item order; no payment or delivery is performed
post.description: Browser writes require Origin equal to APP_ORIGIN. App writes require X-Client-Type: app and a Bearer token. The response name follows the browser locale cookie or App Accept-Language. English and Chinese name snapshots and the owner are derived on the server. Excellent options are only allowed when the game item permits them.

parameters.name: Accept-Language
parameters.description: App clients: en, zh-CN, or es. Browser clients use r2f2-locale Cookie instead.

get.summary: List the authenticated player's game accounts

200.description: Own accounts and character total levels

post.summary: Create a game account owned by the authenticated player
post.description: Browser writes require Origin equal to APP_ORIGIN. App writes require X-Client-Type: app and Bearer authentication. The owner email is derived from the verified session and cannot be supplied by the client.

Signup may create a user. A verified existing email returns EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED before sending mail; an unverified email may continue signup. Login never creates a user and does not disclose whether the address exists. Turnstile CAPTCHA is required.

parameters.name: X-Client-Type
parameters.description: App clients must set app. App protected operations require Bearer Token and ignore cookies.

parameters.name: Origin
parameters.description: Required and must equal APP_ORIGIN for browser write operations.

400.description: INVALID_INPUT / OTP_INVALID / AUTH_FAILED / CAPTCHA_REQUIRED / CAPTCHA_FAILED / WEBAUTHN_*
